metadata.title: Clicked like I was petting my cat and somehow stole 1 kill?! Valorant aim’s drunk again
metadata.description:
Me: pretending to chill but somehow landed a hit
Enemy: probably uninstalling out of sheer confusion
How did that even happen? No clue, but I’m cashing in
If your aim’s a lovable disaster, you get this madness

Tap if your aim ever surprises you mid-chaos!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckykill #funnygaming #shorts
